visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a young woman with long dark hair, wearing a silky pale pink robe and chemise, sitting elegantly on a modern, curved white sofa. The room is bathed in soft, natural daylight filtering through sheer white curtains, creating a serene and airy atmosphere. She leans her head back against the sofa with a relaxed expression, her hands resting gently on the cushions. To her left, a small round table holds a modern lamp and a few books. (2) A close-up shot transitions to the woman's hands as she holds a clear plastic pump bottle with a yellow liquid and a label that reads HARU GLOW. She presses the white pump dispenser, and a small amount of clear oil drops onto the palm of her hand. The background is a soft-focus interior, emphasizing the product. She then begins to rub the oil onto her other hand and forearm, her skin appearing hydrated and glistening under the bright indoor lighting. (3) The focus shifts to her neck and décolletage as she applies the massage oil. Her fingers move in smooth, upward strokes, showing the silk-like glide of the product. She has a faint, appreciative smile, and her facial features are clearly visible in the medium close-up shots. The lighting remains bright and warm, highlighting the texture of her skin and the delicate lace trim of her nightgown. (4) The woman is then seen applying the oil to her bare legs while sitting on the sofa. She massages her calves and feet with focused, gentle movements. Later, she changes into a white, sleeveless dress and stands before a mirror in a well-lit room. She picks up a rectangular glass perfume bottle with a black cap, labelled HARU HAPPY SHAME, and sprays it onto her neck and wrist. (5) In the final sequence, she poses with the various HARU products—two bottles of massage oil and the perfume. She smiles warmly at the camera, looking refreshed and confident. The video concludes with a clean white screen featuring the minimalist black logo HARU with a small amber droplet icon in the middle.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a light, melodic pop-influenced background music with a moderate tempo around 105 BPM. A female voice enters with a calm, professional, and friendly tone, speaking at a moderate pace. The acoustics are studio-clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio. No ambient noise is present. (2) A clear, short mechanical click and a soft liquid squish sound are heard as the pump dispenser is activated around 0:04. The narrator's voice maintains its warm, narrative quality, describing the ingredients like damask rose. The BGM continues with a steady, soft electronic beat and synthesizer pads. (3) Faint, low-frequency rustling and sliding sounds of skin-on-skin contact occur, synchronized with the visual massage. The narration becomes slightly more animated and excited when discussing the emotional effect of the fragrance. The music maintains a consistent volume, providing a gentle rhythmic bed. (4) Two distinct, sharp psst airy sounds of a high-pressure spray nozzle signify the perfume application around 0:43. The narrator details the scent notes of pink pepper and musk with clear articulation and a rising intonation pattern. The spectral brightness of the track is high, giving it a modern, crisp feel. (5) The narration concludes with a soft, inviting closing statement. The background music swells slightly for a second before fading out into a very short, high-pitched digital ding or bell sound as the logo appears at the end, marking a clean production finish.

The video uses soft lighting, silky textures, and a soothing narration to appeal to consumers seeking emotional and physical stress relief through fragrance and skincare.
